name: Apple Developer
summary: Apple's developer portal for building apps on its platforms: docs, videos, Xcode, design resources and membership.
description: Apple's portal for building apps on Apple platforms: documentation and sample code, videos, Xcode and OS betas, design guidance and resources (Human Interface Guidelines, Apple Design Resources for Figma and Sketch, SF Symbols, system fonts), and the Apple Developer Program. A free account covers betas, forums and events; the $99/year program adds distribution, TestFlight, analytics and code-level support.
